instruction: Place an Amazon order as per my Amazon shopping list note in SimpleNote.
notes: The note in SimpleNote is found by search_notes and read by show_note; its contents (which products, their quantities, and which saved address name to ship to) are encoded as static facts (listed-in, wanted-quantity, product-query, note-address) that only become usable once (note-read) holds. The shopping list is modeled with two representative items; a real note may list a different number of items, in which case the search/add pair repeats per item and place-order takes one product/quantity pair per item. The cart is cleared first so the order contains exactly the listed products (CartEntry changes are ignored by the checker). Addresses are only looked up with show_addresses and never modified; the existing Home/Work address matching the note is used. supervisor-complete-task is parameterless (no answer requested); its precondition (checkout-done) is set only by place-order, whose preconditions enforce the correct items, quantities and address, so the explicit ground goal facts are implied. Non-API parameters (note, order, products, quantities) are appended after the API parameters.
